scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.start: npm run build:client && npm --prefix server run start
scripts.test: npm run test:server && npm run test:client
scripts.lint: npm run lint:server && npm run lint:client
scripts.format: npm run format:server && npm run format:client
scripts.format:check: npm run format:check:server && npm run format:check:client
